exposure: Group III: healthy preterm infants with gestational ages of 34-36 weeks
Group I: infants with gestational ages of 25-31 weeks
Group II: infants with gestational ages of 32-33 weeks
cohort: 93 preterm infants with severe perinatal pathology
finding: The development of renal dysfunction in preterm infants is associated with various adverse factors during pregnancy and childbirth, leading to a higher risk of acute kidney injury and long-term urinary system complications.
